คลินิก สวท เวชกรรม ภูเก็ต (Phuket PPAT Medical Clinic)
text:
I want to help all the girls who were looking for information about abortion in Phuket and ended up at this clinic.
At the time of this review, the clinic is open Thursdays from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. You should arrive early and get in line if you don't want to wait all day or not see the doctor at all. We arrived around 10:30 AM and didn't see the doctor until 3:30 PM. It was really crowded (but there's a Central shopping center nearby, so you can wait there).

So, you enter the clinic barefoot (put on socks if you're worried about that), approach the very nice girl in the lobby, and she gives you a ticket with a number. Then you wait while she processes everyone who arrived before you. Once you're in line, you'll be called and given a time when the doctor will be ready to see you. After that, you can go about your business. I recommend arriving half an hour before your scheduled appointment, as the doctor may see you earlier (this happened to me; they saw me about 15-20 minutes early). Next, you'll be called in by a doctor with whom you'll discuss your concerns. The doctor is very professional, performs the ultrasound very gently (she doesn't press hard on your abdomen, as is often the case) and listens fully to you. She offers solutions and clearly describes the entire procedure. If your English is poor, the doctor will speak to you through a translator. Then you'll receive instructions and medications to address your concerns. Or, if, for example, the ultrasound doesn't show a fetus, you won't receive them.

I saw the doctor rushing between the reception and her office, trying to see as many women as possible during her workday. Yet, the quality of the consultation doesn't suffer. This inspires respect; it's rare to find such a doctor.
The doctor will also provide her WhatsApp number so you can receive information about the abortion procedure and contact you if you have any problems. Personally, I was extremely pleased with my visit to this hospital. Everything was handled very clearly and correctly, from the registration process to the administration and dispensing of pills. Thank you.
